title: Mastercraft Stratus A/S 235/50R18 97V: fit-check guide before buying
meta_description: A source-backed fit-check guide for the Mastercraft Stratus A/S 235/50R18 97V tire: verify vehicle size, load, speed and cold pressure first.
intro: The Mastercraft Stratus A/S 235/50R18 97V listing describes an all-season passenger tire for sedans and CUVs. This guide explains what that description confirms, what it cannot confirm, and the vehicle information to check before ordering.
verdict: Treat 235/50R18 97V as a product specification, not a universal fitment decision. Order only after your vehicle placard or owner’s manual confirms the required size, load capability, speed capability, and cold inflation pressure.

faq.question: Does 235/50R18 97V guarantee that this tire fits my vehicle?
faq.answer: No. The code identifies the listed tire’s size and service description, but fitment also depends on the vehicle manufacturer’s specified size, load and speed requirements, wheel compatibility, and the vehicle configuration. Check the Tire and Loading Information Label or owner’s manual before ordering.

faq.question: What should I compare before buying a replacement tire?
faq.answer: Compare the listing’s tire size and service description with the vehicle placard or owner’s manual. Also verify that the seller’s fitment tool, installation process, warranty conditions, and local availability apply to your exact vehicle and intended use.

faq.question: Which tire pressure should I use after installation?
faq.answer: Use the vehicle manufacturer’s recommended cold inflation pressure shown on the Tire and Loading Information Label or in the owner’s manual. NHTSA advises checking tires when cold; a pressure printed on the tire sidewall is not a substitute for the vehicle specification.
